clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Leatherworking directs fledgling leatherworkers to seek advanced instruction on crafting durable wilderness shelters. Guided to Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village, craftsmen learn to stitch protective tents that offer essential rest across long expeditions into the wilds.

For traveling leatherworkers, the ability to work hide and pelt into durable wilderness gear is vital. Upon learning the craft, tradesfolk are directed to seek out Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village to learn how to fashion a proper camping tent. Such shelters keep adventurers dry during relentless downpours and cool beneath blazing suns, ensuring they stay well-rested throughout long journeys.

Pitching a tent requires respect for civil boundaries, as townsfolk take issue with crude campsites cluttering municipal streets. Camps must be pitched out in the wild. Furthermore, a sturdy shelter is only half the equation: no campsite is complete without a warming campfire, prompting adventurers to visit a local cook to pick up basic firemaking skills before striking out into the wilds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, adventurer. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.
With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
